about_the_game:
🍽️ About This Game – Cosmic Café

You are the new owner of the once-legendary Cosmic Café. With the previous owner missing and the galaxy ravaged by a ruthless corporate overlord, Take charge and restore the café to its former glory and discover the mystery behind your new and unexpected role.

🍽️ Manage & Upgrade Your Café

Bring this forgotten café back to life with new machines, décor, and custom asteroid biomes. Upgrade your kitchen and cafe tools to serve up exotic dishes and premium services 
(Choose Carefully) for your customers to enjoy.

🧭 Explore Biomes & Gather Ingredients

Venture into artificial ecosystems crawling with hostile creatures, G.R.S. soldiers, and unstable environments. Battle your way through shifting artificial biome systems to collect rare alien ingredients for your menu.

🧪 Transform Your DNA & Adapt

Use the Cafe's advanced technology to Harvest DNA from mutated lifeforms and transform yourself. Grow tentacles, mantis blades, or icy paws—each unlocking new powers for traversal, combat, and survival.

👽 Rescue and Serve your Customers

The Gecks—a once peaceful native species —have been taxed and brainwashed into servitude.  Rescue them and turn them into loyal café customers.

⚖️ Fight Back Against the Galactic Revenue Service

The Galactic Revenue Service will stop at nothing to shut you down. Master alien-level tax evasion and defend your café from surprise audits, sabotage, and raids while uncovering the truth behind their grip on the universe. Use the cafe to grow your power and influence and stop them here. 

About the Developer
Cosmic Cafe is a solo passion project by Michael, a 3D designer who’s spent the last few years helping indie studios build worlds, design levels, and create unique art styles.

While working as a designer with other teams to fund this games development, Michael began crafting Cosmic Cafe, a game born from a love of shop sims and first person combat, where you don’t just run a café… you fight to keep it alive. Set in a bizarre, handcrafted space environment, Cosmic Cafe is a world without boundaries — one where creativity, chaos, and weird alien food collide.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Quad-Core
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Manage a wild alien space café! Explore bizarre biomes, harvest strange ingredients, and battle mutated creatures. Upgrade your gear, mutate your DNA, and fight to restore the galaxy’s most legendary restaurant.
